nodes.proofTerm: fun v_var_x v_var_y h_sum h_prod => rfl

fun v_var_x v_var_y h_sum h_prod jjdep_n_arith => by
  calc
    v_var_x ^ (2 : ℕ) + v_var_y ^ (2 : ℕ) = (v_var_x + v_var_y) ^ (2 : ℕ) - 2 * (v_var_x * v_var_y) := by ring
    _ = (13 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) - 2 * (30 : ℝ) := by rw [h_sum, h_prod]
    _ = (109 : ℝ) := by norm_num
